description: This file defines the 'Function' class, which models a mathematical function with properties like name, minimum argument count, and maximum argument count. It includes constructor validation, accessor methods, and a toString method.

classes.name: Function
classes.description: Represents a mathematical function with a specific name and argument count constraints.

methods.name: Function
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a Function object with a name and argument count, validating input.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the function.

methods.name: getMinimumArgumentCount
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of arguments the function accepts.

methods.name: getMaximumArgumentCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of arguments the function accepts.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the Function object, including its name and argument counts.
